kernel_adaptation_genuineness.claim_matc.reason: The cyclic support construction is implemented and used, but the paper's full kernel differs from the implementation. The paper multiplies both local and far-field covariance by the nonstationary amplitude factors. The code applies those factors only to the local covariance and adds an unmodulated far-field term. Point-dependent amplitude modulation cannot generally be absorbed into three constant corridor coefficients.
